one_line: The paper empirically analyses power transformer energy losses and power-quality-driven efficiency improvements in the internal electrical distribution grids of four industrial end-users (automotive, textile, aluminium profile extrusion, and chemical products factories), none of which are continuous-flow Corpus-B process industries.
